relationships.subject: brilliant blue G
relationships.evidence_quote: The inhibition of spinal P2X7R with BBG could effectively inhibit BCP due to suppressing the expression of NF-kappaB p-p65, NLRP3 inflammasome formation, and downstream pain factors IL-1beta.

relationships.subject: P2X7 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X7 siRNA could reduce microglial activity, the nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB, and the synthesis of NLRP3 and IL-1beta in BV2 cells.

key_findings: Spinal P2X7R inhibition with BBG relieved bone cancer pain and suppressed NF-kB p-p65, NLRP3 inflammasome formation and IL-1beta.
P2X7 siRNA reduced microglial activity and NLRP3/IL-1beta synthesis in BV2 cells; nigericin partly reversed this.
